glucose.t: Dose adjustment and increased frequency of glucose monitoring may be required when Insulin Aspart Protamine and Insulin Aspart is concomitantly administered with these drugs.
Drugs that May Decrease the Blood Glucose Lowering Effect of Insulin Aspart Protamine and Insulin Aspart Drugs:
